source_title: ‘Prahaar’ Day 15 Box Office: Rs 29 lakh Friday haul after 3.6% uptick
source_excerpt: 'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' witnessed a small improvement in its box office performance on Friday, October 30. The Rajkummar Rao-starrer collected Rs 29 lakh in India on its 15th day. This marked a 3.6% increase from Thursday's earnings of Rs 28 lakh. However, the film continued to record modest daily collections after its second-week slowdown.According to Sacnilk, the film's Friday earnings came from 914 shows across India. It recorded an average collection of Rs 3,173 per show. The latest figures take its domestic net collection to Rs 21.86 cr. Its India gross earnings have reached Rs 26.01 cr, while the worldwide gross stands at Rs 28.96 cr.'Prahaar' records a modest recovery on Day 15The film's latest collection offered a slight improvement after two consecutive days of declining earnings. Its third day remains the strongest performer so far, with a collection of Rs 3.65 cr. The Friday figure was considerably lower than that peak. The film also registered an overall occupancy of 10% across its shows, according to the daily collection data.Despite the small increase, the film has struggled to maintain the momentum it built during its opening week. Its collections have remained below the crore mark since the beginning of its second week, except for the weekend performances.Second-week collections fall by 74.2%'Prahaar' opened with Rs 2.35 cr and gained momentum over its first weekend. It collected Rs 3.15 cr on Saturday before reaching its highest single-day figure on Sunday. The film maintained a relatively strong run through the first week, finishing the period with Rs 17.15 cr in India net collections.The second week brought a sharp change in its box office trend. Although Saturday and Sunday offered some relief, the film's weekday collections dropped considerably. It ended the week with Rs 4.42 cr, registering a 74.2% decline compared with its opening week. 'Prahaar' worldwide box office collectionThe film's overseas performance has added Rs 2.95 cr to its overall gross earnings. Combined with its domestic business, this has taken the worldwide total to Rs 28.96 cr. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 26.01 cr, against a domestic net total of Rs 21.86 cr.The Hindi 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 13.11% on Friday. Morning shows registered 2.69%, while afternoon screenings recorded 6.15%. The figure improved to 13.15% during the evening. Night shows performed better, with occupancy reaching 19.23%.The film had 914 shows on its 15th day, compared with 1,156 shows on Thursday. Its latest average of Rs 3,173 per show provides another indication of the limited audience turnout during the day.Rajkummar Rao plays public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' explores the career of public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam and his involvement in some significant criminal trials in India. The story revisits the legal battles surrounding the 1993 Bombay blasts and the 2008 Mumbai attacks. It focuses on Nikam's role in the proceedings connected to these major cases.Rajkummar Rao plays the lead role in the film, which also features Wamiqa Gabbi, Lalit Prabhakar, Jaideep Ahlawat and Sikandar Kher. The film was released in theatres on October 16, 2026.
